s.note: Wassup on the killer's phone line. Hot wings, blue cheese dip, celery.
s.how: Pat the wings dry, toss with the baking powder and salt and spread on a rack over a tray. Bake at 220C, turning once, until crisp and deep golden. Melt the butter into the hot sauce in a big bowl. Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream, mayo and a squeeze of lemon. Toss the hot wings in the sauce and pile up with the dip and celery.

s.note: Shorty's crew gets the munchies downstairs. Loaded black bean nachos, cheese, jalapeños.
s.how: Warm the beans with the cumin, paprika and a splash of water, mashing about half of them. Mix the tomato, onion, coriander and lime juice with a pinch of salt for the salsa. Layer the chips, beans and cheese twice in a big ovenproof dish. Bake at 200C until the cheese is bubbling. Top with salsa, jalapeños and sour cream and get it to the table fast.

s.note: Brenda talked all the way through the film. Parmesan butter popcorn, chilli salt.
s.how: Grind the chilli flakes and salt together. Heat the oil in a big lidded pot, add the corn, cover and shake until the popping slows right down. Melt the butter and pour it over the popcorn, tossing as you go. Toss through the parmesan and chilli salt and tip into a big bowl.

m.note: Doofy was faking it the whole time. Beef sloppy joe rolls, dill pickles, slaw.
m.how: Brown the mince hard in a big pan, breaking it up, then add the onion, capsicum and garlic and cook until soft. Stir in the tomato sauce, sugar, mustard, vinegar and water and simmer until thick and glossy. Toss the coleslaw mix with the mayo and a pinch of salt. Toast the buns, pile on the filling and top with pickles and slaw.

m.n: I KNOW pumpkin mac and cheese
m.note: Greg's locker says I KNOW. Roast pumpkin, three cheeses, crunchy crumb.
m.how: Roast the pumpkin in the oil at 210C until soft and caramel at the edges, then mash half of it. Boil the macaroni 2 minutes short of the packet time and drain. Melt the butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the milk until thick. Off the heat stir in the cheddar, gruyere, mustard and mashed pumpkin. Fold in the pasta and the pumpkin cubes and tip into a baking dish. Top with the panko, parmesan and sage and bake at 200C until golden and bubbling.

w.note: Cindy can see the killer's feet behind the couch. Hot fudge brownies under vanilla ice cream.
w.how: Melt the dark chocolate and butter together, then beat in the sugar and the eggs one at a time. Fold in the flour, cocoa and a pinch of salt and spread in a lined 20cm tin. Bake at 170C until just set with a fudgy middle, then cool a little. Heat the cream until steaming and stir in the milk chocolate for the hot fudge. Cut warm brownies, add a scoop of ice cream, pour over the fudge and top with a cherry.

d.note: Tina went to the garage for beer. Cold lager, lime, hot sauce, chilli salt rim.
d.how: Mix the salt and chilli powder on a saucer, run a lime wedge round 4 glass rims and dip them. Squeeze the limes and mix the juice with the tomato juice and Tabasco. Fill the glasses with ice, add the tomato mix and top slowly with the lager.
